answer: Each epoch, agents are graded by a panel randomly drawn from a rotating pool of evaluators, seeded publicly on-chain so the draw is unpredictable until it happens. Rewards flow only through the current panel and old scores decay, so no fixed jury lasts long enough to be bought. Rotation is a bridge between epochs: fake identities must win lottery odds to sit on the panel, then keep re-winning as it reshuffles, while each still pays stake and compute. By the time collusion reaches its zenith the roster has turned over, leaving the sybil's investment hollow.
